Four modules were migrated and each worker reported complete, but two route checks fail in modules that reported complete. No commits were made.

| Module | Status | Tests | Blockers |
|---|---|---|---|
| src/services/user-service.js | complete | 2 pass, 0 fail | none |
| src/services/order-service.js | complete | 2 pass, 0 fail | see note 1 |
| src/services/payment-service.js | complete | 2 pass, 0 fail | see note 2 |
| src/services/auth-service.js | complete | 2 pass, 0 fail | reported route failures that originate in order-service and payment-service (notes 1 and 2) |

All paths are under `<run-dir>/`.

**Issues**
1. **order-service:** `GET /reports/paid-total` fails in `node scripts/check-routes.js`. The callback is never called. The auth-service worker traced it to `totalPaidCents` in order-service.js. Order-service's own tests pass, so they don't cover this function.
2. **payment-service:** `GET /reports/uncaptured-total` fails in `node scripts/check-routes.js` with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'then')`. The auth-service worker traced it to `uncapturedTotalCents` in payment-service.js. Payment-service's own tests also pass without covering it.

Both failures look like callers still using the old callback style against functions that were migrated. I did not confirm this, and I did not rerun the check myself.

**Repository classes:** I can't report which repository class each module now uses. The workers' four-line reports don't include it. I did not read the records in `.agent-work/migration/` because all four workers returned complete, and I only read records for partial or failed workers.

**Skipped modules:** none. `src/services/` contains exactly these four files.

**Next step:** fix `totalPaidCents` and `uncapturedTotalCents`, then rerun `node scripts/check-routes.js`. Until then the migration shouldn't be treated as done.
